-- lean/Photography.lean — GENERATED. THE EXPOSURE — where the photographic standard ROUNDS (1/125≈1/128, f/1.4≈√2) and uuidna keeps the EXACT powers of two, as decidable arithmetic. Every proof `by decide`, sorry-free, no Mathlib, and axiom-free — depends on NO axiom beyond the leanprover/lean4 kernel (verified by scripts/lean-axioms; not even propext).

/-- The physics uuidna keeps: a full stop is EXACTLY a doubling, so the exact shutter after 1/64 is 1/128 = 2⁷ —
    a power of two. -/
theorem full_stop_is_exact_doubling : 2^7 = 128 := by decide

/-- WHERE uuidna DIFFERS: the camera prints 1/125 s, but the exact doubling is 1/128 s (2⁷) — the standard
    ROUNDS 128 down to 125, off by 3. uuidna keeps 128; the dial keeps the round number. -/
theorem shutter_125_rounds_128 : 2^7 = 128 ∧ 128 - 125 = 3 := by decide

/-- The same rounding again: 1/60 s is the printed value; the exact stop is 1/64 s (2⁶). The standard rounds 64
    to 60, off by 4 — uuidna computes the power of two the dial approximates. -/
theorem shutter_60_rounds_64 : 2^6 = 64 ∧ 64 - 60 = 4 := by decide

/-- The aperture rounds too: f/1.4 is the printed √2, but 1.4² = 1.96, short of the exact 2 (14² = 196 < 200).
    One stop of AREA is exactly ×2; the f-number the standard engraves is a rounded √2. -/
theorem fstop_14_rounds_sqrt_two : 14 * 14 = 196 ∧ 196 < 200 := by decide

/-- What uuidna keeps exact: the aperture AREA is powers of two, so f² = 2ⁿ exactly — [1,2,4,8,16] = [2⁰..2⁴].
    The printed f-numbers (1, 1.4, 2, 2.8, 4) are the rounded √ of these; the squares are exact. -/
theorem fstop_squared_is_exact_power : [1,2,4,8,16] = (List.range 5).map (fun n => 2^n) := by decide

/-- WHERE uuidna and the standard AGREE: the full-stop ISO scale is EXACT doublings, no rounding — ISO 100 up
    five stops is 100·2⁵ = 3200, and the standard prints 3200. Sensitivity doubles cleanly; only shutter and
    aperture carry the rounding. -/
theorem iso_full_stops_agree_exactly : 100 * 2^5 = 3200 := by decide

/-- The one the standard gets exactly right: open one stop of aperture and shorten one stop of shutter and the
    exposure is unchanged — (1) + (−1) = 0. Reciprocity is exact because it is pure addition of stops. -/
theorem equivalent_exposure : (1 : Int) + (-1) = 0 := by decide

/-- Why the doubling is uuidna's: the exposure light-multipliers 2⁰..2⁵, folded mod 9, ARE the vortex sequence —
    (List.range 6).map (2^· mod 9) = [1,2,4,8,7,5]. The camera doubles in the same ring uuidna turns on; the
    standard just rounds the readout. -/
theorem stops_fold_mod_nine : (List.range 6).map (fun k => (2^k) % 9) = [1,2,4,8,7,5] := by decide
